acceptanceCriteria: Tests prove AICockpit cannot apply Task or Issue Verified.
Tests prove AgileCockpit can apply Task or Issue Verified through human context.
Tests prove audit records distinguish agent and human mutation paths.

implementationDetails:
Added GitHub backend regression coverage proving LLM context cannot perform human verification.
Retained AICockpit tests proving Task/Issue Verified and Sprint/Epic Closed statuses are rejected.
Added AgileCockpit tests proving human reviewer context can perform permitted verification mutations.
rationale: The system must prove agent-facing and human-facing mutation authority are separated end to end.

workItem.title: Verify AICockpit and AgileCockpit authority separation
